floor_history.headline: Recon s1: canonical island respell (func_800274BC form) lowered floor 33->30 with insn parity 144==144; full residual map banked; disc-copy survival is the frontier head.

frontier.hypothesis: The disc copy can survive to reorg under an honest spelling once the folding pass is identified
frontier.mechanism: either cse1 canon_reg replaces ud's uses with disc inside the beqz-extended block (LABEL_NUSES==1 extension), or combine folds the then-single-use copy; target proves the original copy reached reorg (it sits in the delay slot)
frontier.next_probe: pwsh tools/grinder/dump.ps1 func_8002D518; read .cse and .combine for the ud pseudo; then try the cse-block-extension escape (if/else arm ending in jump+BARRIER per cse-block-extension-controls-fold-span.md); only after honest spellings die, evaluate staged-value-reused-variable / param-reuse (threshold dead after entrance chains) / duplicated-statement-into-arms with their rules' prerequisites

frontier.hypothesis: The remaining register cascade (dist_sq/sqrt_val/t1-t2/result) is coupled to the disc-copy allocation and largely collapses once the copy takes $a0 and disc moves to $a2
frontier.mechanism: the copy occupying $a0 forces disc to $a2 in local/global alloc; downstream tie-breaks then re-run with different occupancy
frontier.next_probe: re-run sandbox + full objdump diff immediately after any surviving-copy form; only attack residuals that remain

frontier.hypothesis: The two ordering flips (dist_sq addu placement in the mult cascade; denom sll placement before div) are independent scheduler items needing their own levers
frontier.mechanism: sched1 rank/priority on the mult-shadow filler insns; possibly sensitive to declaration/use order of dist_sq, c_val, denom
frontier.next_probe: after frontier-1/2 settle: try moving dist_sq computation after c_val in source and denom decl after t1 numerator; read .sched dump before attributing
